newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CS First Boston rates Richter as 'hold'.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston rates Richter as 'hold'.

text.p: In a company update CS First Boston rated the shares in Richter Gedeon Rt as 'hold' following the publication of the pharmaceutical company's full-year results on Tuesday.
"We are maintaining our 'hold' recommendation on Richter following the publication of its full-year results," CSFB's Budapest based analyst Spencer Jakab said.
"The stock appears to have reached its fair value range and its 42 percent premium to (peer company) Egis on EV/EBITDA criteria seems excessive," he said.
Richter's 1996 IAS sales of 36.76 billion forints were one percent above CSFB's forecast, Jakab said.
However, its gross profit of 22.52 billion was three percent below CSFB's forecasts, reflecting higher sales of low-margin bulk chemicals and contraceptives, he said.
Richter's operating income of 9.07 billion forints was 2.4 percent below CSFB's forecast, he added.
The analyst said they have raised Richter's 1997 and 1998 earnings/share forecasts to reflect higher expected interest income.
